Research at the UvA
Research at the UvA
With more than 3000 scientists we conduct interdisciplinary, innovative and independent research that makes a difference in society.
Our strategic themes
Across these domains, we combine expertise from various disciplines and work with partners to address current societal challenges.
Systemic and Fair Climate Solutions
Healthy future
Fair and resilient societies
Responsible digital transformations
All research areas
All other research themes
In focus: Gender and sexuality
How equal is the Netherlands today when it comes to gender and sexuality? UvA researchers provide an answer.

Organisation
Organisation of research
Research at the UvA is carried out within research institutes and centres. We also participate in Dutch research schools and institutes abroad.
Find an employee
Search for researchers by name and faculty in our employee overview.
Research institutes, centres and schools
An overview of the research institutes, centres and schools at the University of Amsterdam.
Vision and quality assurance
Vision on research
Solving complex societal challenges through innovative and interdisciplinary research.
Awards and grants
Our researchers are supported by research awards and grants from various organisations in the Netherlands and abroad.
Academic integrity
Everyone involved in teaching and research has a role to play in safeguarding academic integrity.
Research assessments
Our research is regularly reviewed by external and independent experts, in line with Dutch national protocol.
Collaborating with third parties
Research collaborations are important. New collaborations are assessed based on ethical guidelines.
